input.change_text: Added a new command \`/best-of-n\` that runs the same task in parallel across multiple models, each in its own isolated worktree, then compares outcomes.

output.subject: /best-of-n slash command runs the same task across multiple models
output.action_text: Try `/best-of-n` in `cursor` 3.0+ when you want to A/B a task across models — it runs the same prompt in parallel, each in an isolated worktree, then compares outcomes. Opt-in; no impact on consumers who don't invoke it.
